newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA DOMESTIC DEBT EDGES UP TO 2.558 TRLN LEVS.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA DOMESTIC DEBT EDGES UP TO 2.558 TRLN LEVS.

text.p: Bulgaria's domestic debt edged up by 74.6 billion levs in April to 2.558 trillion levs mainly because of net sales of government securities, a Finance Ministry official said on Monday.
"The increase in the government domestic debt in April was due to net sales of government securities," a Finance ministry official, who declined to be named, told Reuters.

Net sales of government securities in April totalled around 226 billion levs but the lev rise against the dollar erased some 154 billion levs off the value of dollar-denominated government securities, Finance ministry figures showed.
The Finance Ministry placed last month $50 million of 18-month, floater coupon T-notes with the country's biggest state-owned Bulbank under a stabilisation plan for the ailing state Biochimbank.
Under a government decree the Finance ministry placed the issue with Bulbank to fund the buy-back of $50 million of dollar-denominated bad debt (ZUNK) bonds at par value from Biochimbank's portfolio.

The lev gained to 1,450.0 per dollar on April 30 from 1,588.8 on March 31 in the central bank daily fixing used in the calculations as the interim cabinet launched urgent stabilisation measures and won funding pledges from international lenders.
The lev traded near 1,570 per dollar on the local interbank market on Monday.
Finance ministry's direct loans from the Bulgarian National Bank and the State Savings Bank rose by 2.2 billion levs to 140.745 billion levs in April.

The ministry issued $79.2 million of floater coupon T-bonds last year to guarantee foreign currency deposits of companies and individuals in five local banks against which the central bank has filed insolvency suits.
Bad debt bonds worth 32 billion levs and $1.8 billion respectively were issued three years ago to cover banks' non-performing loans extended to state companies before 1991.
The total par value of dollar-denominated bad debt bonds in circulation at end-April was $918.8 million and lev-denominated bonds amounted to around 20 billion levs worth.
